articles.title: The National Championship Where 750 Teens Get Down and Dirty—Literally
articles.summary: At the 75-year-old National Land and Range Judging Contest in Oklahoma, 750 FFA and 4-H students analyzed soil for farming and construction potential. One Kentucky freshman drove 15 hours to compete, calling it a dream fulfilled. It's a serious science competition disguised as playing in the mud.

articles.title: France vs. Morocco: A World Cup Quarterfinal Loaded with Talent and Tension
articles.summary: In a rematch of the 2022 semifinal, France and Morocco meet in the World Cup quarterfinals at Foxborough Stadium. Kylian Mbappe's 7 goals lead a star-studded French attack, but Morocco's disciplined defense and growing confidence make them genuine contenders. Colonial history adds an extra layer of intrigue.

articles.title: Food for Peace's Identity Crisis: Humanitarian Lifeline or Farm Subsidy?
articles.summary: After being dismantled by the Trump administration, the historic Food for Peace program was resurrected under USDA. But humanitarian experts argue the agency lacks expertise and is prioritizing U.S. agricultural interests over starving populations. The Senate must now decide its fate.
